review_scope: Complete 35-line article read, including all19 candidates, metadata, rowheader wrappers, nine-policy/eight-surface table, 72 independently accounted applicability cells, NOTE caveat and annotate-only footnote. Eight additional scope/limitation assertions retained. Support means policy applicability, not functional availability or actual configuration. No adoption, rights, rendered-version, target assurance or independent omission certificate.

claims.statement: The policy-surface article uses the Copilot cloud feature definition; actual target entitlement remains independent.
The article describes IDE, CLI, website-agent and chat surfaces; naming a surface does not certify every policy there.
Each supported feature/surface has a dedicated enable/disable policy, distinct from customization policies.
Not every customization/control policy applies to every available surface; scope must be assessed policy by policy.
Table support indicates whether a policy applies, not whether equivalent functionality exists on the surface.
Cloud agent can access the Internet even though the Copilot web-search policy does not govern that capability; Disabled web search does not prove network isolation.
Public-code matching policy is supported for cloud and third-party agents only in annotate mode, not inferred blocking mode.
The agent responsible-use limitations anchor requires separate review; a linked footnote is not rights clearance or runtime proof.
